{"id": "8a5dba18-ca54-416c-8c26-1244ec9033ca", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Yes. The `-mantle-input-tokens-` part of that usage type means the usage was billed on the `bedrock-mantle` endpoint, so the mantle quota is the one that applies to you.

**What the docs say**
- The Bedrock Cost and Usage Report documentation lists `*-mantle-input-tokens-*` and `*-mantle-output-tokens-*` as the usage-type patterns for `bedrock-mantle` traffic. `bedrock-runtime` traffic uses the plain `*-input-tokens` and `*-output-tokens` patterns.
- Your `USE1-anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-mantle-input-tokens-standard` line matches the mantle pattern. It also shows the us-east-1 Region and the Standard service tier.
- Bedrock tracks the two endpoints against separate per-model quotas, even for the same underlying model. Throttling on `bedrock-runtime` and cross-Region inference profiles is governed by different quotas.

**What this means for throttling**
- The relevant quota is "Bedrock Mantle input tokens per minute for Claude Sonnet 5". You'll find it in Service Quotas under Amazon Bedrock if you search for "Bedrock Mantle". It is per model and per Region, so it applies to us-east-1 here.
- The matching output-tokens-per-minute quota applies too.
- The quota is shared across every API on that endpoint for the model: Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses.
- Mantle has no requests-per-minute quota. Only the token quotas throttle you.
- Cached input tokens read through prompt caching don't count against the input quota.
- The input check counts your input tokens plus the requested `max_tokens` when a request is admitted. The unused part is returned after the response completes. A large `max_tokens` can therefore cause throttling at lower real usage.

**Caveats**
- You might also have `bedrock-runtime` usage for the same model, for example through the Converse API or a cross-Region inference profile. That usage would show up as separate usage types without "mantle" in the name, and it would count against a different quota.
- I didn't check the quota values in your account. I can look up your current Bedrock Mantle quota for Claude Sonnet 5 in us-east-1 and compare it with your recent usage. Tell me if you want that.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
